lesson: STR_791 orthogonal residual scoring concept is sound (cross-sectional regression removes Defense overlap from momentum), but implementation has 6 PIT violations: same-day VT/DD (C2/C9), old MRS without lag (C5/C11), FM tilt using today's cum returns (C8), liquidity frollmean without shift (C10). Estimated SR inflation 25-50% from VT/DD/FM same-day plus ~18% from old MRS (L-441). Post-correction SR likely ~0.6-0.7. FF5 alpha t=1.47 not significant. CAGR already below target. Concept worth reimplementing with regime_engine v7.1 + all lag fixes applied.
reuse_note: Orthogonal residual decomposition (regress factor A on factor B, use residual as independent alpha) is a valid technique. Apply to new Factor DB strategies with PIT-clean infrastructure.
